complete_written_definition.literal_source:
structure RationalLogCertificate where
  argument : ℚ
  terms : ℕ
  lower : ℚ
  upper : ℚ
  deriving DecidableEq, Repr

def RationalLogCertificate.Valid (c : RationalLogCertificate) : Prop :=
  1 ≤ c.argument ∧
    c.lower ≤ logSeriesLower c.argument c.terms ∧
    logSeriesUpper c.argument c.terms ≤ c.upper

def RationalLogCertificate.check (c : RationalLogCertificate) : Bool :=
  decide c.Valid

complete_written_types_and_proofs.name: private logParameter_bounds
complete_written_types_and_proofs.complete_written_type:
private theorem logParameter_bounds {q : ℚ} (hq : 1 ≤ q) :
    0 ≤ logParameter q ∧ logParameter q < 1 := by
complete_written_types_and_proofs.complete_written_proof_body:
have hden : 0 < q + 1 := by linarith
  constructor
  · exact div_nonneg (sub_nonneg.mpr hq) hden.le
  · change (q - 1) / (q + 1) < 1
    exact (div_lt_one hden).mpr (by linarith)

complete_written_types_and_proofs.name: private logParameter_identity
complete_written_types_and_proofs.complete_written_type:
private theorem logParameter_identity {q : ℚ} (hq : 1 ≤ q) :
    (1 + logParameter q) / (1 - logParameter q) = q := by
complete_written_types_and_proofs.complete_written_proof_body:
have hden : q + 1 ≠ 0 := ne_of_gt (by linarith : 0 < q + 1)
  unfold logParameter
  field_simp [hden]
  ring

complete_written_types_and_proofs.name: RationalLogCertificate.check_sound
complete_written_types_and_proofs.complete_written_type:
theorem RationalLogCertificate.check_sound (c : RationalLogCertificate)
    (hcheck : c.check = true) :
    (c.lower : ℝ) ≤ Real.log (c.argument : ℝ) ∧
      Real.log (c.argument : ℝ) ≤ (c.upper : ℝ) := by
complete_written_types_and_proofs.complete_written_proof_body:
have hv : c.Valid := of_decide_eq_true hcheck
  rcases hv with ⟨hq, hlo, hhi⟩
  obtain ⟨hx0, hx1⟩ := logParameter_bounds hq
  have hx0R : (0 : ℝ) ≤ (logParameter c.argument : ℝ) := by exact_mod_cast hx0
  have hx1R : (logParameter c.argument : ℝ) < (1 : ℝ) := by exact_mod_cast hx1
  have heq : (1 + (logParameter c.argument : ℝ)) /
      (1 - (logParameter c.argument : ℝ)) = (c.argument : ℝ) := by
    exact_mod_cast logParameter_identity hq
  have hl := Real.sum_range_le_log_div hx0R hx1R c.terms
  have hu := Real.log_div_le_sum_range_add hx0R hx1R c.terms
  rw [heq] at hl hu
  have hlCast : (logSeriesLower c.argument c.terms : ℝ) =
      2 * ∑ i ∈ Finset.range c.terms,
        (logParameter c.argument : ℝ) ^ (2 * i + 1) /
          (2 * (i : ℝ) + 1) := by
    simp [logSeriesLower]
  have huCast : (logSeriesUpper c.argument c.terms : ℝ) =
      (logSeriesLower c.argument c.terms : ℝ) +
        2 * (logParameter c.argument : ℝ) ^ (2 * c.terms + 1) /
          (1 - (logParameter c.argument : ℝ) ^ 2) := by
    simp [logSeriesUpper]
  have hloR : (c.lower : ℝ) ≤ (logSeriesLower c.argument c.terms : ℝ) := by
    exact_mod_cast hlo
  have hhiR : (logSeriesUpper c.argument c.terms : ℝ) ≤ (c.upper : ℝ) := by
    exact_mod_cast hhi
  rw [hlCast] at hloR
  rw [huCast, hlCast] at hhiR
  simp only [mul_div_assoc] at hhiR
  constructor <;> linarith

lemma sum_range_sub_log_div_le {x : ℝ} (h : |x| < 1) (n : ℕ) :
    |1 / 2 * log ((1 + x) / (1 - x)) - ∑ i ∈ range n, x ^ (2 * i + 1) / (2 * i + 1)| ≤
      |x| ^ (2 * n + 1) / (1 - x ^ 2) := by

lemma sum_range_le_log_div {x : ℝ} (h₀ : 0 ≤ x) (h : x < 1) (n : ℕ) :
    ∑ i ∈ range n, x ^ (2 * i + 1) / (2 * i + 1) ≤ 1 / 2 * log ((1 + x) / (1 - x)) := by

lemma log_div_le_sum_range_add {x : ℝ} (h₀ : 0 ≤ x) (h : x < 1) (n : ℕ) :
    1 / 2 * log ((1 + x) / (1 - x)) ≤
      (∑ i ∈ range n, x ^ (2 * i + 1) / (2 * i + 1)) + x ^ (2 * n + 1) / (1 - x ^ 2) := by
  have h₁ := sum_range_sub_log_div_le (by rwa [abs_of_nonneg h₀]) n
  rwa [abs_of_nonneg (sub_nonneg_of_le (sum_range_le_log_div h₀ h n)), abs_of_nonneg h₀,
    sub_le_iff_le_add'] at h₁

@[simp, norm_cast] lemma cast_add (p q : ℚ) : ↑(p + q) = (p + q : α) :=
  cast_add_of_ne_zero (Nat.cast_ne_zero.2 p.pos.ne') (Nat.cast_ne_zero.2 q.pos.ne')

@[simp, norm_cast] lemma cast_sub (p q : ℚ) : ↑(p - q) = (p - q : α) :=
  cast_sub_of_ne_zero (Nat.cast_ne_zero.2 p.pos.ne') (Nat.cast_ne_zero.2 q.pos.ne')

@[simp, norm_cast] lemma cast_mul (p q : ℚ) : ↑(p * q) = (p * q : α) :=
  cast_mul_of_ne_zero (Nat.cast_ne_zero.2 p.pos.ne') (Nat.cast_ne_zero.2 q.pos.ne')

@[simp, norm_cast] lemma cast_inv (p : ℚ) : ↑(p⁻¹) = (p⁻¹ : α) := map_inv₀ (castHom α) _
@[simp, norm_cast] lemma cast_div (p q : ℚ) : ↑(p / q) = (p / q : α) := map_div₀ (castHom α) ..

@[simp, norm_cast]
lemma cast_pow (p : ℚ) (n : ℕ) : ↑(p ^ n) = (p ^ n : α) := by
  rw [cast_def, cast_def, den_pow, num_pow, Nat.cast_pow, Int.cast_pow, div_eq_mul_inv, ← inv_pow,

theorem of_decide_eq_true [inst : Decidable p] : Eq (decide p) true → p := fun h =>
  match (generalizing := false) inst with
  | isTrue  h₁ => h₁
  | isFalse h₁ => absurd h (ne_true_of_eq_false (decide_eq_false h₁))

independent_soundness_audit.validity_and_check: Valid requires1<=q, stored lower<=the exact rational finite lower, and exact rational finite upper<=stored upper. The local Decidable instance follows rational order and finite expressions. check=decide Valid; of_decide_eq_true unfolds check definitionally and recovers those exact premises. Soundness is conditional on a proof of check=true, not on trusting a producer.
independent_soundness_audit.argument_and_parameter_domains: q>=1 implies q>0 and q+1>=2>0. Therefore x=(q-1)/(q+1) satisfies0<=x<1. Strict x>0 is unnecessary and would wrongly exclude q=1; both actual Real.sum_range_le_log_div and Real.log_div_le_sum_range_add require exactly0<=x and x<1.
independent_soundness_audit.denominator_signs: For every i,n in Nat,2*i+1 and2*n+1 are positive. From0<=x<1 follow1-x>0,1+x>0,x^2<1,and1-x^2>0. Thus the logarithm ratio is positive and the tail denominator is positive. The source uses the direct native bounds with precisely their required parameter hypotheses; it does not need to add ad hoc positivity premises to the public theorem.
independent_soundness_audit.parameter_identity: With q+1!=0 from q>=1, the private identity proves(1+x)/(1-x)=q by exact rational algebra. Its rational equality casts to the identical real equality, and rw[heq] replaces the native logarithm argument by the supplied rational q.
independent_soundness_audit.native_lower: The actual API is S_n<=1/2*Real.log((1+x)/(1-x)). Combining this with lower<=2*S_n yields the desired stored lower<=Real.log q. The factor2 is accounted for only by linear arithmetic, with no extra series assumption.
independent_soundness_audit.native_upper: The actual API is1/2*Real.log((1+x)/(1-x))<=S_n+x^(2n+1)/(1-x^2). The rational upper uses exactly twice this unsharpened tail. No omitted(2n+1) divisor or improved external tail is smuggled into the certificate.
independent_soundness_audit.casts_and_final_linear_step: Rat.cast_sum,cast_pow,cast_div,cast_add/sub/mul and ordered casts give hlCast,huCast,hloR,hhiR. Natural odd denominators become2*(i:Real)+1. mul_div_assoc aligns2*xpower/denom with2*(xpower/denom); final linarith then combines the two half-log native inequalities with the exact twice-series endpoint inequalities.
independent_soundness_audit.no_log_oracle: Real.log appears only in the semantic theorem conclusion and native Mathlib bounds, never in Valid or check. Stored endpoints can be arbitrary producer suggestions; they become useful only through proved exact rational comparisons. deriving Repr/DecidableEq supplies representations/decisions, not a real-number oracle.
